flowSteps: Select a vaccine from the WHO EPI presets, or enter custom Arrhenius parameters (Ea, k_ref, reference temperature).
Enter each temperature exposure interval — temperature (°C) and duration (hours).
View the result: calculated Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT), remaining potency, and VVM-equivalent risk level.
Review past assessments in History — stored on this device only.
help.safetyTitle: The physical VVM label always takes priority
help.safetyDesc: VaxGuard's result is a calculated estimate for planning and training purposes. If the vial has a physical Vaccine Vial Monitor (VVM) label, its actual reading always overrides this app's calculation. If the two disagree, VaxGuard will flag a mismatch warning — follow the physical VVM in that case.

termList.desc: A single equivalent constant temperature that represents a series of variable temperature exposures, per WHO TRS 961 Annex 9.
A heat-sensitive label on the vaccine vial. Stage 1 = usable, through Stage 4 = discard.

help.customDesc: Only enter Ea, k_ref, and reference temperature values from a reliable source — the manufacturer's data sheet or WHO documentation. Do not guess these numbers; an incorrect value can produce a misleading result.
help.dataDesc: Assessment history is stored only in this browser's local storage on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
